senses.gloss: m. (v. קוֹפָא II), ק׳ דמרא the handle of a hoe, contrad. to פדא blade; [oth. opin.: קוּפִּינָא (cmp. קוּפָּא I, 2) that part of the hoe which contains the hole for the insertion of the handle, the blade, v. פַּדָּא].
units: <cite ref="Gittin 32a:1">Gitt. 32ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 102b:8">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>שופתא בק׳ דמרא</he> the pin which fastens the handle to the blade.
